name: Animatronic Live Follow
author: pgianotto
description: Face-tracking servo control for animatronics. Keeps a detected face centered in frame using pan/tilt servos. Supports always-on, show-triggered, FPP command, and motion-sensor trigger modes. Install uses uv to fetch a Python 3.12 runtime from GitHub (MediaPipe has no build for newer Python on the Pi); the tracking model is downloaded once from storage.googleapis.com.

privacy.summary: Uses your camera to keep a detected face or body centered in frame by moving pan/tilt servos. Runs on this device only; no video or tracking data is saved.

sends.what: a request for the face/body tracking model file (no personal or performance data)
sends.why: one-time download of MediaPipe's tracking model the first time tracking is used

systemChanges.what: installs and enables the fpp-live-follow systemd service running the tracking daemon
writes /etc/apache2/conf-enabled/fpp-live-follow-proxy.conf, an Apache proxy route on FPP's web server
adds this plugin's folder to git's system safe.directory list (/etc/gitconfig)
installs uv via pip and a Python 3.12 runtime from github.com (astral-sh/python-build-standalone) into /home/fpp/.local
clones the pinned tracking core library from github.com/pgianotto/animatronic-motion-system
